description: An infinite cardinal k is regular exactly when every subset of k.ord of cardinality below k has a strict upper bound below k.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.Cofinality.regular_iff_bounded.{u} (k : Cardinal.{u}) (hk : Cardinal.aleph0 ≤ k) :
  k.IsRegular ↔ ∀ (s : Set k.ord.ToType), Cardinal.mk ↑s < k → ∃ b, ∀ x ∈ s, x < b
